image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab served on a white plate. The crab's carapace is reddish-orange with some darker mottling. Several legs and claws are visible, appearing disjointed or broken, typical of a prepared meal. A metal crab cracker tool rests in the foreground. The background includes blurred elements of the dish, possibly onions or garnish.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The legs appear somewhat disconnected or 'floating' near the body. The anatomy of how the legs attach to the thorax is ambiguous and slightly melted, lacking clear joint definition typical of a real biological specimen, though this could be attributed to the cooking/preparation style.
The texture on the dark tip of the foreground claw appears slightly smudged or painterly compared to the sharper gloss of the carapace, suggesting minor generation inconsistency.
The metal tool in the foreground has slightly warped geometry where the handles meet, and the reflection is inconsistent with the surrounding lighting.
